skill.summary: Transform AI-generated content into natural, human-sounding writing, measure the improvement, and optionally verify the result.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of verified-humanizer skill.

- Transforms AI-generated text into natural, human-sounding writing.
- Measures before/after improvement using structured metrics.
- Keeps user text private and all rewriting local.
- Offers optional structured verification without exposing original content.
- Provides clear output with rewritten text, change log, and evaluation data.
